_comment: Mouse variant for when the EMG does not separate wake from sleep cleanly, or the recording is too short for the EMG power to be reliably bimodal. Instead of thresholding the EMG, everything is clustered together into WAKE / NREM / REM with the EMG used as an extra clustering feature. Same signal processing as mouse.json; only the steps differ.

steps._comment: EMG power is min-max scaled to [0, 1], so a threshold above 1 can never be exceeded and every epoch becomes SLEEP. nosignal_threshold still removes flat or disconnected stretches, so set it from the histogram.
steps.name: wake_sleep

steps._comment: One step recovers all three stages. use_emg adds EMG power as a feature, which is what separates wake here since the threshold no longer does.
steps.name: split_all
